teslaToggleFSD.title: Toggle FSD
teslaToggleFSD.desc: Engage or disengage the Tesla UI autopilot (FSD). Bind it to a wheel button.

teslaToggleAutosteer.title: Toggle Autosteer
teslaToggleAutosteer.desc: Engage or disengage steering-only autopilot. Bind it to a wheel button.

teslaVoiceNote.title: Voice note (iPad mic)
teslaVoiceNote.desc: Opens the iPad mic in the app so you can record a voice note for a future update.

teslaNudge.title: Hands-on nudge
teslaNudge.desc: Counts as a steering-wheel nudge for the FSD attention monitor.

teslaPaddleLeft.title: Paddle left (turn signal)
teslaPaddleLeft.desc: Left turn signal; with FSD it asks for a left turn / lane change.

teslaPaddleRight.title: Paddle right (turn signal)
teslaPaddleRight.desc: Right turn signal; with FSD it asks for a right turn / lane change.

teslaDialUp.title: Dial turn up
teslaDialUp.desc: The G29 red dial: volume / follow distance / speed / profile up.

teslaDialDown.title: Dial turn down
teslaDialDown.desc: The G29 red dial turned the other way.
